notes: Tasks specialist on the shared OS floor. Ordinary create uses create_task and writes immediately; edits use update_task (Confirm). Other chat workbench writes use clare_mutate and wait for Confirm. Paths are propose-action `tasks:task:<id>` / `tasks:project:<id>`. Work blocks/sessions use `tasks:work_block:*` / `tasks:work_session:*`. Life remember/track/research use propose-action. People: search_people reads; propose_* tools queue `people:person:*` / `people:organisation:*` / `people:link:*` / `people:observation:*` / `people:remember:*` writes for Confirm. Travel: propose_travel_item / propose_travel_checkin → `travel:trip:*`. Hub prefs: propose_hub_prefs → `tasks:meta:hub_prefs` (Constraints still CN patch; bedtime still calendar ghost).
